narrative.intro: This ranking lists the fastest-growing federal contract markets for FY2026 to date, measured by year-over-year growth in contract obligations. The federal government obligated $227B in contract dollars in the same fiscal period. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction grew 179.6% year over year. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction grew 166.5% year over year. Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services grew 116.3% year over year. Automobile Manufacturing grew 100.4% year over year. Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology) grew 56.8% year over year. Software Publishers grew 40.3% year over year. Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction grew 38.8% year over year. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing grew 34.0% year over year. Telecommunications Resellers grew 33.7% year over year. Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction grew 33.5% year over year. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date).

sections.heading: Which industries topped the list for fastest growth?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction led the list with 179.6% growth. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction and Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services followed at 166.5% and 116.3% respectively. Automobile Manufacturing rounded out the top four at 100.4%.

sections.heading: What broader trends does the ranking show?
sections.body: Construction-related industries dominate the list, with multiple construction categories showing double-digit growth. Manufacturing and technology-adjacent categories, including Automobile Manufacturing, Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing, and Software Publishers, also appear among the fastest growers.

faq.q: What are the fastest-growing federal contract markets?
faq.a: The fastest-growing federal contract markets are Commercial and Institutional Building Construction, Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction, Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services, Automobile Manufacturing, Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology), Software Publishers, Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction, Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing, Telecommunications Resellers, and Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction grew 179.6% year over year and Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction grew 166.5% year over year, with the other listed industries showing the stated year-over-year growth rates.

faq.q: How is market growth measured here?
faq.a: Market growth is measured by year-over-year percent change in contract obligations for the same fiscal period. The ranking compares the current FY2026 to date obligations against the same period in the prior year, and current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date).
